payload.description: Reproduced failure across 2 executions with identical context.
payload.action: Review Loop iteration 2 finding detected: FIND-R2-002-01
symptoms: The hermetic reset (reset --hard + clean -fdx) leaves .git internals untouched, so hooks and local config (core.hooksPath, core.fsmonitor, smudge filters) planted by PR-authored code executing in a prior pass persist and can run during, and falsify, the next pass's checkout while the head-SHA verification still passes; scrub .git/hooks and non-remote local config (or neutralise them via -c overrides) on the reuse path and correct the 'hermetically equivalent to a fresh clone' claim in README.md and docs/git_flow.md.
